Disability Services Officer

Happy Days Support Service Pty Ltd
Gold Coast

Full-time | Permanent

About Happy Days

Happy Days Support Service Pty Ltd is a growing disability support provider delivering high-quality, person-centred supports to children and adults living with intellectual, physical, neurological, psychosocial and developmental disabilities.

We are committed to empowering participants through education, skill development, community inclusion and individualised support that promotes independence and improves quality of life.

We are currently seeking an experienced Disability Services Officer to join our growing team to oversee program development and service coordination.

About the Role

The Disability Services Officer is responsible for assessing participant needs, developing and implementing individual support and capacity-building programs, coordinating services, monitoring participant outcomes and delivering person-centred disability supports across a variety of community and accommodation settings.

This position requires a professional who can work collaboratively with participants, families, allied health professionals and community organisations to ensure participants receive high-quality supports that promote independence, inclusion and achievement of NDIS goals. The role focuses on case management, program design, and service coordination rather than direct personal care.

Key Responsibilities:

- Assess participants’ individual needs, strengths and support requirements to design comprehensive service agreements and support plans.
- Develop, implement and review individual education, life skills, training and support programs.
- Interview participants and families to assess the nature and extent of support needs.
- Monitor participant progress and maintain accurate case notes, reports and documentation.
- Review participant outcomes and recommend modifications to support strategies where required.
- Assist participants to access appropriate community, health, welfare, housing, employment and training services.
- Liaise with families, support coordinators, allied health professionals, government agencies and community organisations to coordinate participant supports.
- Promote participant independence, community inclusion and social participation through systematic program development.
- Support participants in developing daily living, communication, social and life skills by training and guiding frontline support staff on individual support plans.
- Coordinate and supervise the implementation of complex care plans, ensuring frontline staff adhere to established behavioural and lifestyle goals.
- Provide direct disability support including personal care, community access, behavioural support and assistance with daily activities where required.
- Implement and monitor Positive Behaviour Support strategies in accordance with behaviour support plans, providing guidance to operational staff.
- Ensure services are delivered in accordance with NDIS Practice Standards, organisational policies and relevant legislation.
- Contribute to participant reviews, goal planning and continuous improvement initiatives.


Essential Skills & Experience

The successful applicant will demonstrate experience in:
- Assessing participant needs and identifying appropriate support strategies.
- Planning, developing and implementing educational, life skills and support programs.
- Monitoring participant progress and preparing professional reports.
- Coordinating supports with families, allied health professionals and external agencies.
- Supporting people living with intellectual, physical, psychosocial and developmental disabilities at a case-management or supervisory level.
- Promoting participant choice, dignity, independence and community participation.
- Building positive relationships with participants, families and stakeholders.
- Working within a multidisciplinary and person-centred framework.
- Maintaining accurate electronic documentation and records.
- Applying excellent communication, problem-solving and organisational skills.

Essential Requirements:

- Advanced Diploma or Diploma in Disability, Community Services, Case Management, or a relevant higher education qualification.
- Current NDIS Worker Screening Clearance.
- Current Working with Children Check (Blue Card).
- Current First Aid and CPR Certificate.
- Current Australian Driver Licence.
- Ability to work flexible hours including weekends.

Why Join Us?

- Permanent full-time position.
- Ongoing professional development.
- Supportive leadership team.
- Diverse participant caseload.
- Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in people’s lives.

Pay: $75,000.00 – $83,000.00 per year

Industry Experience: 1 year (Preferred)

Their services span property and facility management, hospitality service delivery, cleaning and presentation standards, and day-to-day operational support for the properties and clients under management.

This is a full-time role with an annual salary of $80,000 to $81,000 plus superannuation.

Reporting to senior management, the Service Manager is responsible for organising and controlling the cleaning services operations delivered across Kaza Group's managed portfolio of properties, ensuring consistent cleaning and presentation standards, effective staffing, regulatory compliance, and sound financial management across the cleaning service function, alongside oversight of related facility and hospitality service support.

Responsibilities include:

•	Organising and controlling the day-to-day cleaning services operations across Kaza Group's managed portfolio, coordinating cleaning teams and presentation standards across all managed properties and client sites.

•	Promoting and selling Kaza Group's cleaning and presentation service packages to property Owners and clients, and identifying opportunities to expand the range of cleaning services provided across the portfolio.

•	Observing and ensuring compliance with occupational health and safety requirements, chemical handling and other regulations applicable to the cleaning services and properties managed.

•	Liaising with property owners, clients, and contractors to ensure cleaning service delivery meets agreed expectations, and preparing regular reporting on cleaning service performance across the portfolio.

•	Managing the day-to-day administration of the cleaning services function, including rostering, incident reporting, quality audits, and staff performance management.

Qualifications:

•	Excellent written and oral communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with property Owners, clients, contractors, and staff at all levels.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to assess service issues and develop practical, effective solutions.

•	Sound financial management skills, including budgeting and cost control experience.

•	Detail-oriented, with the ability to multitask, work independently and prioritise competing operational demands across a portfolio of sites.

Position Overview
We are looking for a Motion Picture Systems Analyst to support the design, analysis and continuous improvement of technology solutions that enable efficient film, television and digital media production. This role works closely with production, post-production and business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, optimise workflows and implement business systems that enhance collaboration, media management and production performance. The ideal candidate is an analytical problem solver with strong systems analysis experience and the ability to bridge business needs with technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Examine production, post-production and digital content workflows to identify opportunities for improving system performance, operational efficiency and information flow.
Consult with producers, production managers, editors, technical teams and business stakeholders to gather, analyse and document functional and technical requirements.
Evaluate existing production systems and recommend technology enhancements that improve scheduling, resource planning, media asset management and workflow automation.
Develop functional specifications, business requirements, workflow diagrams and process documentation to support software development and system integration activities.
Analyse business processes and operational procedures to ensure technology solutions align with production objectives, compliance requirements and organisational standards.
Coordinate the implementation of new applications, software enhancements and production workflow solutions while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
Design, prepare and execute system, integration and user acceptance testing to validate functionality, performance and business requirements before deployment.
Investigate system issues, perform root cause analysis and recommend practical solutions that improve system reliability, usability and operational effectiveness.
Prepare user manuals, technical documentation and training materials, and deliver training sessions that support successful adoption of new technologies.
Collaborate with software developers, infrastructure teams, vendors and third-party providers to integrate production management, digital asset management and enterprise business systems.
Contribute to project planning by assisting with solution design, implementation schedules, resource estimation, risk identification and project documentation.
Provide technical advice and ongoing support to stakeholders, acting as the primary liaison between business users and technical teams throughout system enhancement initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of systems analysis methodologies, business process improvement and software development lifecycles.
Experience gathering business requirements and producing functional specifications, process models and technical documentation.
Knowledge of business process modelling, workflow analysis and system implementation methodologies.
Experience supporting system integration, software deployment and user acceptance testing.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical thinking skills with the ability to recommend practical technology solutions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing demands and meet project deadlines.
Proficiency with enterprise applications, databases and business systems within technology-driven environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Cleaning Service Manager
Employer: Clear Wash Pty Ltd
Location: Gladesville, NSW (servicing commercial clients across Sydney)
Position: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: AUD $80,000 – $90,000 plus superannuation
About the Company
Clear Wash Pty Ltd is a growing commercial cleaning company providing professional cleaning services to offices, retail premises, medical facilities and commercial buildings throughout Sydney. We are committed to delivering reliable, high-quality cleaning services while maintaining excellent customer relationships and industry best practices.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Cleaning Service Manager to oversee our commercial cleaning operations and ensure the efficient delivery of services across multiple client sites.
Key Duties and Responsibilities
•	Promoting and selling Clear Wash's commercial cleaning services by building and maintaining strong relationships with existing and prospective clients and responding to service enquiries.
•	Planning, organising and coordinating day-to-day commercial cleaning operations, including staff allocations, cleaning schedules, equipment requirements and service delivery across multiple client sites and cleaning contracts.
•	Controlling the recruitment, induction, training, supervision and performance management of cleaning supervisors and cleaning staff to ensure quality service delivery.
•	Planning, sourcing, purchasing and managing cleaning chemicals, consumables and equipment and liaise with suppliers to ensure adequate stock levels and cost-effective procurement.
•	Developing, implementing and reviewing customer service procedures, operational policies and cleaning programs to continuously improve service quality and client satisfaction.
•	Establishing, implementing, monitoring and reviewing cleaning service standards, performance benchmarks and quality assurance measures, including site inspections and client feedback, to ensure contractual and company standards are consistently achieved.
•	Maintaining operational and financial records, preparing and managing operational budgets, monitoring labour costs, equipment expenditure and consumable usage, and implementing cost-control measures to ensure services are delivered within approved budgets.
•	Ensuring compliance with Work Health and Safety (WHS), chemical handling requirements, environmental regulations, infection control standards and other relevant legislation, company policies and industry standards.
•	Managing operational standards, including site security procedures, key management, housekeeping practices, equipment maintenance and quality assurance across all client sites.
•	Investigating and resolving customer enquiries, grievances or complaints and service issues promptly while maintaining strong ongoing client relationships.
•	Assisting the Directors in implementing business improvement initiatives and identifying opportunities to expand cleaning service contracts.
Essential Requirements
•	A relevant AQF Diploma or higher qualification (or overseas equivalent), or at least 3 years of relevant management experience in commercial cleaning, facilities management or a closely related service industry.
•	Demonstrated leadership and staff management experience.
•	Excellent organisational, communication and customer service skills.
•	Strong knowledge of commercial cleaning operations and quality assurance.
•	Sound understanding of Work Health and Safety legislation and compliance requirements.
•	A current Australian Driver Licence.
Salary
AUD $80,000 – $90,000 per annum plus superannuation, depending on qualifications and experience.
How to Apply
Please submit your resume together with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the position at luke@clearwash.com.au. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

A growing commercial cleaning and facilities services business is seeking an experienced Corporate Services Manager to oversee business operations, service delivery, client relationships and portfolio performance across South Australia, Victoria and Western Australia.

This is a senior management position suited to someone with strong experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations, client relationship management, workforce leadership and operational performance.

The successful candidate will work closely with the executive leadership team to ensure operational standards, labour performance, compliance, client satisfaction and business growth objectives are achieved.

About the Role

The Corporate Services Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating and improving the administrative, operational and commercial functions of an allocated portfolio.

The role will involve oversight of service delivery, client relationships, staffing, performance management, compliance systems, reporting, audits, business improvement and portfolio development opportunities.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can manage competing priorities, support Area Managers and site teams, maintain strong client relationships and contribute to the continued growth and professionalism of the business.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Oversee the administration and operational performance of cleaning and facilities services across the allocated portfolio.
Work with the executive leadership team to support business planning, portfolio performance and strategic objectives.
Monitor labour-to-sales performance, roster structures, site profitability and operational results.
Manage client relationships and act as a senior escalation point for service delivery matters.
Identify opportunities for account growth, additional works, recharges, tender opportunities and new business leads.
Support tendering, quoting and commercial submissions where required.
Lead, support and performance manage Area Managers, Supervisors and cleaning teams.
Ensure appropriate staffing, training, succession planning and workforce coverage across the portfolio.
Monitor compliance with company systems, operational procedures, WHS requirements, audits, toolbox talks and site documentation.
Ensure cleaning standards, site presentation and service quality meet company and client expectations.
Support injury management and return-to-work processes in line with company HR and WHS protocols.
Review site performance data, audit outcomes, customer feedback and operational risks.
Implement process improvements to strengthen consistency, productivity and service delivery.
Represent the business professionally in client meetings, operational reviews and portfolio development activities.
Skills and Experience Required

The successful candidate will ideally have:

Previous experience in a senior operations, corporate services, facilities management or commercial cleaning management role.
Strong experience managing multi-site service delivery teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.
Experience with labour management, rostering, cost control and performance reporting.
Understanding of WHS, compliance, audits and quality standards in a service-based environment.
Ability to lead managers, supervisors and frontline employees across multiple locations.
Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Commercial awareness, including the ability to identify growth, quoting and additional service opportunities.
Strong computer literacy and ability to use business systems, reporting tools and operational platforms.
Current driver licence and willingness to travel as required across the allocated portfolio.
Qualifications

Relevant qualifications in business, management, operations, facilities management or a related field will be highly regarded.

Equivalent industry experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations or service-based management will also be considered.

What We Offer
Senior full-time management role with a growing service-based business.
Salary range of $115,000 - $135,000 per annum plus superannuation.
Company vehicle and fuel card.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Opportunity to work closely with the executive leadership team.
Broad portfolio responsibility across SA, VIC and WA.
Long-term opportunity to contribute to business growth, service improvement and operational excellence.
How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a short cover letter outlining your experience in corporate services, facilities services, commercial cleaning operations, client management and team leadership.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates with the right skills, experience and work rights for the role.
